## DatabaseJobQueue

```k,ignore
@ServerOnly
public service DatabaseJobQueue implements JobQueue
```

The standard [`JobQueue`](#jobqueue), stored in the app's database (`k_job`).

**Members**

- `func enqueue<Payload>(_ kind: JobKind<Payload>, payload: Payload, delay: Duration = 0.seconds) async where Payload implements Codable`
  Stores the job in the current transaction, so it runs only if the
  transaction commits; see [`JobQueue.enqueue`](#jobqueue).

## Email

```k,ignore
@Builder
public struct Email
```

An email message, a `@Builder` struct (`docs/design/31-email.md`).

**Members**

- `let to: EmailAddress`
  The recipient.
- `let subject: String`
  The subject; a line break makes [`EmailProvider.send`](#emailprovider) throw
  [`EmailError.invalidMessage`](#emailerror).
- `let text: String`
  The plain-text part; every message has one.
- `let html: String? = nil`
  The HTML part, sent alongside `text`; none when `nil`.
- `let from: EmailAddress? = nil`
  The sender; [`SmtpConfig.from`](#smtpconfig) (`MAIL_FROM`) when `nil`.
- `let replyTo: EmailAddress? = nil`
  The address replies go to; none when `nil`.
- `let cc: List<EmailAddress> = []`
  The addresses that receive a copy, visible to every recipient.
- `let bcc: List<EmailAddress> = []`
  The addresses that receive a blind copy, hidden from the others.

## EmailError

```k,ignore
public enum EmailError implements Error, Codable
```

Why sending an email ([`EmailProvider.send`](#emailprovider)) failed, matching the
caller's retry decision.

**Members**

- `case unavailable`
  The provider couldn't connect, timed out, or gave a temporary (4xx)
  SMTP reply; worth retrying.
- `case rejected(reason: String)`
  A permanent (5xx) SMTP reply, with the server's text; not worth
  retrying.
- `case invalidMessage(reason: String)`
  The message can't be sent as written (such as a line break in the
  subject).

## EmailProvider

```k,ignore
@Platform(side: .server)
public interface EmailProvider
```

Sends email. A server-only platform interface; [`SmtpEmailProvider`](#smtpemailprovider) is
injected with no `use` rule, and [`k.test.RecordingEmailProvider`](k-test.md#recordingemailprovider)
replaces it in tests.

**Members**

- `func send(email: Email) async throws EmailError`
  Sends `email`.

  - Throws: [`EmailError.unavailable`](#emailerror) for a temporary failure,
    [`EmailError.rejected`](#emailerror) for a permanent one and
    [`EmailError.invalidMessage`](#emailerror) for a message that can't be sent.

## Job

```k,ignore
@ServerOnly
public interface Job<Payload> where Payload implements Codable
```

A background job: a service run by the worker with a stored payload
(`docs/design/30-background-jobs.md`). Server-only. Each job gets a
generated `static let kind: JobKind<Payload>` ([`JobKind`](#jobkind)).

**Members**

- `func run(payload: Payload) async throws JobError`
  Does the work. Called only by the worker and by test code.

  - Parameter payload: the payload the job was enqueued with.
  - Throws: [`JobError.retryable`](#joberror) to run it again after the backoff
    ([`Retry`](#retry)), or [`JobError.permanent`](#joberror) to give up.

## JobConfig

```k,ignore
public config JobConfig
```

The job worker's settings.

## JobError

```k,ignore
public enum JobError implements Error
```

How a job run ([`Job.run`](#job)) failed, which decides whether it is retried.

**Members**

- `case retryable(reason: String)`
  The run failed for now: try again after the backoff ([`Retry`](#retry)).
- `case permanent(reason: String)`
  The run can never succeed: don't try again; the job becomes dead.

```k,ignore
public struct JobName
```

A job's stable name for its rows in the queue:
`@JobName("order-confirmation")`.

## JobQueue

```k,ignore
@Platform(side: .server)
public interface JobQueue
```

Enqueues background jobs, in the enqueuing transaction. A server-only
platform interface; [`DatabaseJobQueue`](#databasejobqueue) is the standard one and
[`k.test.RecordingJobQueue`](k-test.md#recordingjobqueue) replaces it in tests.

**Members**

- `func enqueue<Payload>(_ kind: JobKind<Payload>, payload: Payload, delay: Duration = 0.seconds) async where Payload implements Codable`
  Stores a job to run after `delay`. Doesn't throw.

  - Parameters:
    - kind: the job's handle, `SomeJob.kind`.
    - payload: the value the job's [`Job.run`](#job) receives.
    - delay: how long to wait before the first run.

## PublicUrls

```k,ignore
public service PublicUrls
```

Absolute URLs of the app's pages (`docs/design/12-routing.md`,
"Absolute URLs"), built from typed `Page` values as `link(to:)` is.

On the server they start with the public origin `K_PUBLIC_ORIGIN`; in
the browser with the page's origin, which is the public origin.

**Members**

- `func absolute(_ page: Page) -> Url`
  Returns the absolute URL of `page` ([`k.core.Page`](k-core.md#page)), for emails,
  push notifications, redirects and links to copy.
- `func absolute(endpoint: Endpoint) -> Url`
  Returns the absolute URL of an endpoint page ([`k.core.Endpoint`](k-core.md#endpoint)).
  Server-only, as endpoint pages are.

## Retry

```k,ignore
public struct Retry
```

A job's retry policy: up to `attempts` runs, waiting `backoff` and then
doubling, with jitter. The default is 5 attempts from 10 seconds.

**Members**

- `let attempts: Int`
  The total number of runs, the first one included.
- `let backoff: Duration`
  The wait before the second run; each later wait doubles.

## ScheduleTime

```k,ignore
public enum ScheduleTime
```

When a scheduled job ([`Schedule`](#schedule)) runs.

**Members**

- `case every(Duration)`
  Runs every time the payload duration elapses.
- `case daily(at: TimeOfDay)`
  Runs every day at `at`, UTC.
- `case weekly(on: Weekday, at: TimeOfDay)`
  Runs every week on `on` at `at`, UTC.

## VapidWebPush

```k,ignore
@ServerOnly
public service VapidWebPush implements WebPush
```

The standard [`WebPush`](#webpush): RFC 8030 requests with RFC 8291 encryption
and an RFC 8292 VAPID token, signed with [`PushConfig.privateKey`](#pushconfig).

**Members**

- `var serverKey: EcdsaP256PublicKey?`
  See [`WebPush.serverKey`](#webpush).
- `func send(_ message: SystemNotification, to subscription: PushSubscription, timeToLive: Duration = 1.days) async throws WebPushError`
  See [`WebPush.send(_:to:timeToLive:)`](#webpush).

## WebPush

```k,ignore
@Platform(side: .server)
public interface WebPush
```

Sends push messages to browsers' subscriptions
(`docs/design/50-push.md`), shown there by the app's service worker as
a [`SystemNotification`](k-device.md#systemnotification) even while no tab of the app is open. A
server-only platform interface: [`VapidWebPush`](#vapidwebpush) is injected with no
`use` rule, and [`k.test.RecordingWebPush`](k-test.md#recordingwebpush) replaces it in tests.

No third-party account: the app identifies itself to every browser
vendor's push service with its own VAPID key, `K_PUSH_PRIVATE_KEY`
([`PushConfig`](#pushconfig)), made with `k keys new p256-ecdsa`, and each message
is encrypted to the subscription, so the push service can't read it.

**Members**

- `var serverKey: EcdsaP256PublicKey?`
  The public half of the configured key, which the browser subscribes
  with ([`k.device.PushSubscriptions.subscribe(serverKey:)`](k-device.md#pushsubscriptions)); `nil`
  when `K_PUSH_PRIVATE_KEY` isn't set.
- `func send(_ message: SystemNotification, to subscription: PushSubscription, timeToLive: Duration = 1.days) async throws WebPushError`
  Sends `message` to `subscription`. The push service keeps it for
  at most `timeToLive` while the browser is offline.

  - Throws: [`WebPushError.expired`](#webpusherror) when the subscription is gone
    (delete it), `.unavailable` for a failure worth retrying, and the
    other cases for one that isn't.

## WebPushError

```k,ignore
public enum WebPushError implements Error, Equatable
```

Why [`WebPush.send(_:to:timeToLive:)`](#webpush) didn't deliver
(`docs/design/50-push.md`).

**Members**

- `case expired`
  The subscription is gone (the push service answered `404` or
  `410`): delete it.
- `case unavailable`
  The push service couldn't be reached, timed out, or answered `429`
  or a `5xx`: try again later.
- `case rejected(status: Int)`
  The push service refused the message with `status`, such as `403`
  when the subscription was made with another key.
- `case tooLarge`
  The encrypted message is over the 4,096 bytes push services take.
- `case invalidSubscription`
  The subscription's keys are malformed, or its endpoint isn't
  `https`.
- `case notConfigured`
  `K_PUSH_PRIVATE_KEY` isn't set.
